gaps.sentence: These apples cost two euros ___ kilo.
gaps.explanation: 'A/per' is used for rates: two euros a kilo, twice a week, 60 km an hour.

gaps.sentence: ___ curiosity killed the cat, as they say.
gaps.explanation: 'Curiosity' as an abstract quality takes no article, even in the proverb.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
He joined ___ army when he was eighteen.
gaps.explanation: Institutions take 'the': the army, the police, the church.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.
gaps.explanation: 'Have a wonderful/great/good time' — 'time' here is countable and takes 'a'.

gaps.sentence: It was such ___ awful weather that we stayed indoors.
gaps.explanation: Uncountable nouns take no article after 'such': such awful weather.

gaps.sentence: She works as ___ waitress during the summer holidays.
gaps.explanation: After 'as' and 'work as', jobs take a/an: work as a waitress.
